product.name: Karwa Salam Coach
product.description: A 45–50-seat coach for passenger transportation, equipped with manual or automatic transmission options, luggage storage, fire suppression, suspension choices, and onboard infotainment.

product.name: Karwa School Bus
product.description: A school transportation bus configured for student safety and operational monitoring, with high-back seats, three-point seat belts, luggage storage, infotainment, and child-monitoring equipment.

product.name: Karwa Raha City Bus
product.description: A city bus for urban routes, featuring lightweight integral construction, low entry access, two curb-side doors, low operating costs, and maneuverability for busy streets.

product.name: Karwa VIP Coach
product.description: A 40–50-seat luxury coach with reclining leather seats, optional washroom, refrigerator, infotainment, Wi‑Fi, and USB charging for premium passenger travel.

product.name: Karwa Aman Coach
product.description: A 30–35-seat coach for regional and institutional transportation, with manual or automatic transmission options, covered luggage storage, leaf-spring suspension, fire suppression, and infotainment.
